name: Staking Arena
install:
set -euo pipefail
export NVM_DIR="${NVM_DIR:-$HOME/.nvm}"
. "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"
nvm install 24.22.2
nvm alias default 24.22.2
export PATH="$NVM_DIR/versions/node/v24.22.2/bin:$PATH"
hash -r
NODE_BIN="$NVM_DIR/versions/node/v24.22.2/bin"
sudo ln -sfn "$NODE_BIN/node" /usr/local/cargo/bin/node
sudo ln -sfn "$NODE_BIN/npm" /usr/local/cargo/bin/npm
sudo ln -sfn "$NODE_BIN/npx" /usr/local/cargo/bin/npx
sudo ln -sfn "$NODE_BIN/corepack" /usr/local/cargo/bin/corepack
[ ! -d '/agent/repos/bch-staking-blaze2026' ] || cd '/agent/repos/bch-staking-blaze2026' || exit $?
npm ci --ignore-scripts
npm --prefix frontend ci --ignore-scripts
start:
set -euo pipefail
export NVM_DIR="${NVM_DIR:-$HOME/.nvm}"
. "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"
export PATH="$NVM_DIR/versions/node/v24.22.2/bin:$PATH"
hash -r
[ ! -d '/agent/repos/bch-staking-blaze2026' ] || cd '/agent/repos/bch-staking-blaze2026' || exit $?
if curl -fsS --max-time 2 http://127.0.0.1:5174/ >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "Staking Arena dev server already listening on 127.0.0.1:5174"
  exit 0
fi
exec npm run blaze:dev
